title: text out of `mixed` is `tainted`, however it is taken out
scope: What a value pulled out of `mixed` carries on the `tainted` axis: every conversion, `.`, interpolation, `is` narrowing, shape target and `foreach` binding that reads text out of `mixed`, and the typed readers of a database row. Not in scope: typed request accessors (`query`/`post` answering `?tainted string`), which are the follow-up step; and the `secret` axis, whose union reach is unchanged.
dependsOnText: [0024](0024.md) § 1 — the qualifier, its sources and the "structured input stays `array<mixed>`" boundary; [0157](0157.md) § 3–4 — `tainted {…}` over a shape, and `tainted mixed` refused; [0067](0067.md) — the row's column map, which already promised `tainted` text.

summary.headline: Text taken out of `mixed` is tainted
summary.body:
Request fields, decoded JSON, session and cache entries arrive as `mixed`. Converting one to text,
joining it into a string or testing it with `is string` now gives `tainted string`, so it cannot reach
a query, a page or a command until it is checked. Converting to a number, a `bool` or an enum stays
clean. A shape that receives the text is written `tainted {…}`.
